senses.definition: To hold someone closely in your arms, usually to show affection, comfort, or friendship.

examples.text: Voy a abrazar a mi mejor amiga cuando llegue al aeropuerto.
examples.translation: I am going to hug my best friend when she arrives at the airport.
examples.emotion: eager and loving, looking forward to a long-awaited reunion

senses.definition: To accept, adopt, or support an idea, belief, or cause with enthusiasm.

examples.text: Ella decidió abrazar nuevas ideas para mejorar su vida.
examples.translation: She decided to embrace new ideas to improve her life.
examples.emotion: determined and open-minded, ready to start a positive change
